sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emili. In this podcast,
we speak slowly. We use easy English. We repeat words again and again. Today we travel to Europe.
We go to Italy. Our city today is Bologna. Bologna is historic. Bologna is warm. Bologna
is full of life and food. Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let's begin our journey.
Part two, Italy and Europe. Italy is a country in Europe. It is famous all over the world.
Italy has history. Italy has art. Italy has food. Many people visit Italy every year.
They come to see cities. They come to eat Italian food. Bologna is not the capital,
but Bologna is very important. It is a real Italian city. Part three, where is Bologna?
Bologna is in the north of Italy. It is in a region called Emilia Romagna.
The city is not near the sea. It is not in the mountains. It is on flat land. Bologna is
easy to reach. Trains come from many cities. People travel here often.
At part four, weather and seasons, Bologna has four seasons. In summer, it is hot. The sun is strong,
and winter it can be cold. Sometimes there is fog. Spring and autumn are nice.
The weather is soft. People enjoy walking outside. The seasons change slowly. Life changes with the
weather. Part five, a very old city. Bologna is a very old city. People lived here long ago.
The city has Roman history. The city has medieval history.
Old buildings are everywhere. Old streets tell stories. When you walk in Bologna,
you walk through history. Part six, the Red City. Bologna is called the Red City. Many buildings are
red. They are made of red bricks. The roofs are red. The walls are red. When the sun shines,
the city looks warm and strong. The color gives Bologna a special feeling.
Part seven, portacos and streets. Bologna is famous for portacos. Portacos are long covered
walkways. You can walk under them. You are safe from sun and rain. The portacos are very long.
They go through the whole city. Walking in Bologna is easy. Walking feels calm and slow.
Part eight, piazza majore. The heart of Bologna is piazza majore. This is the main square.
People meet here. People sit and talk. People enjoy the space. Big buildings are around the square.
Life feels open and social. This place is very important for the city.
At part nine, the old university Bologna has a very famous university. It is one of the oldest
universities in the world. Students come from many countries. They study many subjects.
Young people fill the city. They bring energy and ideas. Because of students, Bologna feels
young and alive. Part 10, food and Bologna. Bologna is famous for food. People love food here.
A famous sauce is bolognese. It is made with meat and tomato. People eat pasta. People eat bread.
People eat together. Food is part of daily life. Meals are long and social.
Part 11, daily life in Bologna. Daily life in Bologna is active. People work. People study.
In the evening, people relax. They walk in the streets. They sit in cafes. Life is not too fast.
Life is not too slow. It feels balanced.
